new_players.note: Wikipedia: Carnmore native; GAA full-back who captained the local hurling team 1910–1916 (pre-Carnmore HC, founded 1944). Breaks Claregalway historic hurling orphan — distinct from modern Claregalway football / Carnmore hurling successor.
